reportForm.title: Report an Incident
reportForm.subtitle: You are not alone. Complete this confidential form to help us connect you with the support services you need.
reportForm.currentlySafe: Are you currently in a safe place?
reportForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Please share any information you feel comfortable providing...
reportForm.confidentialityText: Your information will be handled confidentially and only shared with authorized service providers to help you access the support you need.
reportForm.reportReceived: Your report will still be received, but no follow-up communication will be initiated unless you choose otherwise.
reportForm.submitError: Something went wrong sending your report. Please try again.
reportForm.success: Your report has been submitted successfully.

emergency.title: Emergency Contacts
emergency.instruction: Tap a number to call directly.

safety.title: Right to Safety and Protection
safety.description: You have the right to seek protection from further violence, threats, or harm and to access appropriate safety and protection services.

dignity.title: Right to Dignity and Respect
dignity.description: You have the right to be treated with dignity, compassion, and respect throughout the support and reporting process.

confidentiality.title: Right to Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Your personal information and disclosure should be handled confidentially and shared only when necessary and appropriate.

choice.title: Right to Make Your Own Choices
choice.description: You have the right to receive clear information about available options and make informed decisions about the support you want, where applicable.

nonDiscrimination.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
nonDiscrimination.description: You have the right to receive support without discrimination based on gender, age, disability, background, or other personal circumstances.

medical.title: Right to Health and Medical Support
medical.description: You have the right to seek appropriate medical care and support following violence, including sexual and reproductive health services where needed.

psychosocial.title: Right to Psychosocial Support
psychosocial.description: You have the right to seek counselling and other psychosocial support to help you cope with the effects of violence.

legal.title: Right to Legal Support
legal.description: You have the right to information about legal options and to seek appropriate legal assistance and justice services.

supportServices.title: Right to Access Support Services
supportServices.description: You can seek support from appropriate health, social, police, legal, and protection services depending on your needs.

historyHelp.title: How to clear your browsing history safely
historyHelp.chromeInstructions: Menu (⋮) → History → Clear browsing data → select "History" and "Cookies" → Clear data.
historyHelp.safariInstructions: Settings app → Safari → Clear History and Website Data.
historyHelp.safetyNote: This clears your device's history but not your mobile network or Wi-Fi provider's records. If it's safer, use a friend's phone or a public library computer.
